record.question: Who among the following won the Nobel Peace Prize for 2018?
record.explanation: Answer B: Nadia Murad. The Norwegian Nobel Committee awarded the 2018 Peace Prize jointly to Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad for their work against sexual violence as a weapon of war. Nadia Murad is the only 2018 Peace laureate among the four printed names. Historical/source note: Nadia Murad was a joint laureate, not the sole recipient. Reference: https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2018/press-release/1000/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
